sub_graphs.title: EIP-7805: Inclusion List Proposal Flow
sub_graphs.description: Models the lifecycle of an inclusion list from committee assignment through broadcast

nodes.label: Epoch Boundary Reached
nodes.description: A new epoch has started, triggering committee assignment lookups

nodes.label: Check Inclusion List Committee Assignment
nodes.description: Validator calls get_inclusion_committee_assignment(state, epoch, validator_index) to check if assigned

nodes.label: Assigned to Inclusion List Committee
nodes.description: Validator is assigned to propose an inclusion list for a specific slot

nodes.label: Wait for Block at Slot Start
nodes.description: Validator waits for a block to arrive; if none by ~67% minus 1000ms, uses local get_head()

nodes.label: Retrieve Inclusion List from Execution Engine
nodes.description: Call execution_engine.get_inclusion_list() to get mempool transactions for inclusion enforcement

nodes.label: Construct and Sign Inclusion List
nodes.description: Build SignedInclusionList with slot, validator_index, committee_root, transactions, and BLS signature using DOMAIN_INCLUSION_LIST_COMMITTEE

nodes.label: Signed Inclusion List Broadcast
nodes.description: The signed inclusion list has been broadcast to the P2P network before the submission deadline

edges.label: Query committee assignment for next epoch
Validator is on inclusion list committee for a slot
Block received or timeout, request inclusion list
Sign and broadcast before submission due (~67% slot)

external_entities.name: Execution Engine
external_entities.description: External execution layer client providing get_inclusion_list() with mempool transactions

sub_graphs.title: EIP-7805: Modified Attestation with Inclusion List Awareness
sub_graphs.description: Models how attestation and sync committee behavior changes to incorporate inclusion list enforcement

nodes.label: Attestation Duty Triggered
nodes.description: Validator must create an attestation for the current slot

nodes.label: Compute Attester Head
nodes.description: Call get_attester_head(store, head_root) which may return parent if head is IL-unsatisfied

nodes.label: Create Attestation with Modified Head
nodes.description: Create attestation using the attester head (which accounts for IL satisfaction) rather than raw fork choice head

nodes.label: Attestation Broadcast
nodes.description: Attestation with IL-aware head vote has been broadcast

edges.label: Use attester head for attestation target

sub_graphs.title: EIP-7805: Block Proposal with Inclusion List Transactions
sub_graphs.description: Models how block proposers incorporate inclusion list transactions into execution payloads

nodes.label: Block Proposer Duty Active
nodes.description: Validator has been selected as block proposer for the current slot

nodes.label: Collect Inclusion Lists from Store
nodes.description: Retrieve inclusion lists from inclusion_list_store up to PROPOSER_INCLUSION_LIST_CUTOFF_BPS (~92% of previous slot)

nodes.label: Extract Required Transactions
nodes.description: Call get_inclusion_list_transactions(inclusion_list_store, state, slot-1) to get mandated transactions

nodes.label: Build Execution Payload with IL Transactions
nodes.description: Include inclusion_list_transactions in PayloadAttributes when requesting payload from execution engine

nodes.label: Block Proposed with IL Satisfaction
nodes.description: Block has been constructed with inclusion list transactions included in the execution payload

edges.label: Pass required transactions to execution engine

ambiguities.text: The spec states validators must broadcast by get_inclusion_list_submission_due_ms(epoch) (~67% into slot) but the exact computation is not shown for all edge cases.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume the deadline is computed as slot_start + (slot_duration * 6700 / 10000), consistent with basis point notation used elsewhere in the spec.

ambiguities.text: The behavior when execution_engine.get_inclusion_list() returns an empty transaction set is not explicitly addressed.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume an empty inclusion list is valid — the committee member broadcasts it as-is, indicating no transactions need forced inclusion from their mempool view.

implicit_assumptions.description: The execution engine faithfully returns mempool transactions via get_inclusion_list() without censoring or manipulating the response.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: A compromised execution engine could return empty or manipulated inclusion lists, undermining the censorship resistance the mechanism is designed to provide.

implicit_assumptions.description: Network latency allows inclusion list committee members to receive blocks and broadcast their inclusion lists within the ~67% slot window.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Under high latency conditions, honest committee members may miss the deadline, resulting in fewer inclusion lists and weaker censorship resistance.

implicit_assumptions.description: An attacker controlling a minority of inclusion list committee members cannot prevent honest members from broadcasting their lists.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Network-level attacks (e.g., eclipse attacks) on committee members could suppress inclusion lists, allowing proposers to censor without penalty.
